notes_for_editor: Thin record: three web entries, and the two lookout pages hold no history beyond location and status. Two searches found nothing more about construction, staffing or fires, so the story is short by design. elevation_m is null in the record; the cited 7,932 ft is about 2,417.7 m if the editor wants to fill it.
